name: Westfield Fashion Square
description: Westfield Fashion Square is a premier shopping destination in Sherman Oaks featuring iconic brands like Sephora, Zara, Nike, Adidas, Uniqlo, and Swarovski. The center offers a dynamic mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment with time-saving amenities including click-and-collect services and Smart Parking, making it a convenient all-day destination for the San Fernando Valley community.
demographics: Westfield Fashion Square serves an affluent San Fernando Valley trade area with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households, including young professionals, families with children, and established empty nesters. The center attracts fashion-conscious shoppers aged 25-54 who value convenience and brand variety, with median household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000 in the surrounding Sherman Oaks and Studio City communities. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose trips combining shopping, dining, and entertainment, with strong weekend family traffic and weekday professional shopper activity during lunch hours and after work.
